body.en: Arthropoda is the largest phylum. Arthropods have a chitinous exoskeleton, a body of head, thorax and abdomen, and jointed appendages. They breathe by gills, book gills, book lungs or tracheae, have an open circulatory system, and excrete through Malpighian tubules. Sense organs include antennae, simple or compound eyes and statocysts for balance. Useful insects: Apis (honey bee), Bombyx (silkworm), Laccifer (lac insect); vectors: Anopheles, Culex, Aedes; pest: Locusta; living fossil: Limulus (king crab).
body.kn: ಆರ್ತ್ರೋಪೋಡಾ ಅತಿ ದೊಡ್ಡ ವಂಶ. ಕೈಟಿನ್ ಬಾಹ್ಯಕಂಕಾಲ, ಕೀಲುಯುಕ್ತ ಉಪಾಂಗಗಳು, ತೆರೆದ ರಕ್ತಪರಿಚಲನೆ, ಮಾಲ್ಪಿಜಿಯನ್ ನಳಿಕೆಗಳು. ಲಿಮುಲಸ್ ಜೀವಂತ ಪಳೆಯುಳಿಕೆ.

title.en: On the board: Arthropoda, Mollusca, Echinodermata and Hemichordata

say.en: Four phyla, each with a key mark and examples.
Arthropods: jointed legs, chitin exoskeleton, open circulation, Malpighian tubules.
Molluscs: a muscular foot, a mantle and a shell, and a radula for feeding.
Echinoderms: spiny ossicles and a water vascular system.
Hemichordates: proboscis, collar and trunk; excretion by the proboscis gland.

body.en: Mollusca is the second largest phylum. The unsegmented body has a distinct head, a muscular foot and a visceral hump, covered by a calcareous shell. A soft spongy skin, the mantle, covers the visceral hump, and the mantle cavity holds feather-like gills. The mouth has a file-like rasping organ for feeding, the radula. Examples: Pila (apple snail), Pinctada (pearl oyster), Sepia (cuttlefish), Loligo (squid), Octopus (devil fish), Aplysia (sea hare), Dentalium (tusk shell), Chaetopleura (chiton).
body.kn: ಮೊಲಸ್ಕಾ ಎರಡನೇ ದೊಡ್ಡ ವಂಶ. ತಲೆ, ಸ್ನಾಯು ಪಾದ, ಒಳಾಂಗ ಉಬ್ಬು; ಸುಣ್ಣದ ಚಿಪ್ಪು. ಬಾಯಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಉಜ್ಜುವ ರ‍್ಯಾಡುಲಾ. ಉದಾ: ಪೈಲಾ, ಪಿಂಕ್ಟಾಡಾ (ಮುತ್ತಿನ ಚಿಪ್ಪು), ಆಕ್ಟೋಪಸ್.

narration.en: Mollusca is the second largest phylum. The unsegmented body has a distinct head, a muscular foot and a visceral hump, covered by a calcareous shell. A soft spongy skin, the mantle, covers the visceral hump, and the mantle cavity holds feather-like gills.
narration.kn: ಮೊಲಸ್ಕಾ ಎರಡನೇ ದೊಡ್ಡ ವಂಶ. ತಲೆ, ಸ್ನಾಯು ಪಾದ, ಒಳಾಂಗ ಉಬ್ಬು; ಸುಣ್ಣದ ಚಿಪ್ಪು. ಬಾಯಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಉಜ್ಜುವ ರ‍್ಯಾಡುಲಾ. ಉದಾ: ಪೈಲಾ, ಪಿಂಕ್ಟಾಡಾ (ಮುತ್ತಿನ ಚಿಪ್ಪು), ಆಕ್ಟೋಪಸ್.

body.en: Echinoderms have an endoskeleton of calcareous ossicles, hence the name spiny-skinned. All are marine; adults are radially symmetrical but larvae are bilateral. The water vascular system helps in locomotion, capture and transport of food, and respiration. There is no excretory system. Examples: Asterias (starfish), Echinus (sea urchin), Antedon (sea lily), Cucumaria (sea cucumber), Ophiura (brittle star). Hemichordates are worm-like marine animals with a proboscis, collar and trunk; the excretory organ is the proboscis gland. Once a sub-phylum of chordates, they are now a separate non-chordate phylum. Examples: Balanoglossus, Saccoglossus.
body.kn: ಎಕೈನೋಡರ್ಮ್‌ಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಸುಣ್ಣದ ಅಸ್ಥಿಕಣಗಳ ಒಳಕಂಕಾಲ, ಜಲನಾಳ ವ್ಯೂಹ; ವಿಸರ್ಜನಾ ವ್ಯೂಹ ಇಲ್ಲ. ಹೆಮಿಕಾರ್ಡೇಟ್‌ಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಪ್ರೊಬೋಸಿಸ್, ಕಾಲರ್, ಕಾಂಡ; ವಿಸರ್ಜನೆಗೆ ಪ್ರೊಬೋಸಿಸ್ ಗ್ರಂಥಿ.

problem.en: A marine animal has a spiny calcareous skeleton, tube feet worked by water pressure, and a bilateral larva, but the adult is radially symmetrical. Name the phylum and two examples.

steps.en: A calcareous ossicle endoskeleton with spines suggests Echinodermata.
Tube feet worked by a water vascular system confirm it.
Adult radial and larva bilateral is typical: examples Asterias and Echinus.
